name: Rasmus Andresen - Proposition de résolution
title: REPORT on the global role of the euro
part_text:
The European Parliament wants the euro to be used more around the world, not just inside Europe. It asks the European Commission and the European Central Bank to write a joint plan for this by the end of 2026. The plan should cover more euro borrowing and lending across borders, a shared European safe asset for investors, wider use of the euro in trade and payments, and a digital euro. The report is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It asks for a joint euro strategy by end of 2026.
- **Who it affects:** People and businesses in the EU, especially small firms trading abroad.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and the Central Bank prepare the strategy for Parliament and Council.
